traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The riptide horror can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text:
The riptide horror can climb difficult surfaces, including
upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The riptide horror makes six attacks: three with its
tentacles plus three bites.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:
7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC
14). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the target must
succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1
hour. While the target is poisoned, it is paralyzed. The riptide horror can
have up to 6 creatures grappled with its six tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10
(2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
